name: Szakoly (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Szakoly: a green shield with a yellow bird, with a helm, a crest of ears of grain and blue, green and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szakoly arms with helm, crest and mantling
